Question: My name was mohammad azam arghandavai (place i was born) i liked muddassir to join it with my name instead of arghandavi which is word of quran and name of the holy prophet hazrat mohammad peace be upon him but my father requested me to remian the nick name of arghandabi but i like the name of muddassir to much what should i do which way is better? Answer ID: 1151 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1053/793=H) Act upon the opinion of your father. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
